prompt: Write a one-star review of the Eiffel Tower from an American who has seen the one in Las Vegas.
response:
**★☆☆☆☆ — Total Rip-Off, DON'T Believe the Hype**

Okay so I've been to the REAL Eiffel Tower at the Paris hotel in Las Vegas about six times, and let me tell you, this Paris, France version is a HUGE disappointment.

First off, where's the casino?? I walked around the bottom of this thing for like twenty minutes looking for a slot machine or even a decent buffet and there was NOTHING. Just a bunch of grass and pushy guys selling little keychains. In Vegas you got Gordon Ramsay's restaurant right there. Here? I had to WALK to get food.

Second, they made it WAY too big. It's so far away from everything. In Vegas it's conveniently located right on the Strip, steps from the Bellagio fountains. This one is stuck in the middle of a whole city and you can't even see it from your blackjack table.

Third, and this is the big one — the whole area was PACKED with people speaking French. I thought this was supposed to be a tourist attraction. Barely anyone spoke English and the money was all colorful and weird.

Also no air conditioning ANYWHERE. At least in Vegas you can duck inside and cool off.

Honestly felt like a cheap knockoff of the Vegas original. Save your money and just go to Nevada. Same tower, better parking, and you can gam
